conventions: The selected vertices may share columns.
definition: Given an explicit k × k array of vertices and their edges, no deterministic 2^(o(k log₂ k))-time algorithm decides whether a clique meets every row.
name: k × k Clique Hypothesis
quantifiers: The exclusion concerns the worst-case running time as the number of rows k grows.

source.locator: Section 2, hypothesis definition on p. 2 and deterministic convention on p. 3
